controls.label: Presentation scale
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets the natural-ratio source plane height, capped by safe canvas width.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed source/canvas/time, source plane width and height change proportionally while centre station, source treatment, chapter identity, and exchange progress remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Object-to-room scale defines the Scene composition.

controls.label: Object turn amplitude
controls.serializedMeaning: Bounds yaw during entry, exit, and exchange; readable holds remain at zero yaw.
controls.causalObservation: At a sampled transition, rotateY changes while x path, chapter timing, source opacity/filter/blend, and hold pose stay fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Bounded object turn communicates physical passage without creating continuous sway.

controls.label: Transition depth
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets the bounded mid-transition recession and derived scale/y offset.
controls.causalObservation: At a sampled exchange, depth, scale, and derived y offset change while x endpoints, source order, opacity, filter, and blend remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Depth passage distinguishes object exchange from flat slide movement.

controls.label: Transition direction
controls.serializedMeaning: Chooses the outgoing side; incoming always arrives from the opposite side.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed transition progress, outgoing/incoming x signs mirror while y, depth magnitude, source dimensions, and story order remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Spatial handoff direction is a Scene composition choice distinct from Timeline forward/reverse source order.

controls.label: Placard
controls.serializedMeaning: Shows or hides an accessible external caption for the current readable/incoming source.
controls.causalObservation: Placard semantic/render state toggles without changing any source plane pose, timing, treatment, or media identity.
controls.ownershipReason: External labeling is an explicit Vitrine presentation capability, not source artwork or Look decoration.

serializedIntentNotControls.reason: Source order/reverse is portable Timeline truth.
Spotlight source selection must survive save/scrub/export.
Finale role is semantic story intent, not hidden local selection.

rejectedControls.reason: Source must remain fully faithful; geometry owns exchange.
